BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9158.name: The CretaceousMarshal Lay-Saurer
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A9158.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Spirit effects.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Start of Opposing Attack Step)
You can target an opposing Spirit. During this turn, that targeted Spirit can't attack.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
At the end of the battle, by returning a White Spirit you control to your Hand, this Spirit refreshes.
